question: What biodiesel yield was obtained at 75 °C?
rendered: According to the excerpt from "Engineering a GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 ternary nanocomposite for enhanced electrochemical performance and biodiesel catalysis, page 15," the yield of biodiesel produced from GO-Gd2TiO5 at a temperature of 75 °C was 90.50%.
